title: tp-sl chainIdFor silently falls back to Sepolia (11155111) when CHAIN_ID is missing or invalid
reasoning: chainIdFor(c) = Number.parseInt(c.env.CHAIN_ID, 10) || 11155111 masks configuration errors: every other route (pools.ts line 33-34, positions.ts line 54-55/121, swap.ts line 103-104, price-guard.ts line 83-84) treats an invalid CHAIN_ID as a 500 configuration error, but tp-sl silently binds all reads (getOrder, listByPool, listByUser, getTriggerableOrders) and writes (createOrder) to chain id 11155111. In a misconfigured production deployment, users would silently see empty/wrong-chain order data and new orders would be recorded under the wrong chain id; the create path is only incidentally protected by the RPC chain-id check at line 177 when the RPC chain differs.
reproduction: Deploy without CHAIN_ID; GET /api/v1/tp-sl/orders/1 returns 200/404 on Sepolia-bound data rather than surfacing the misconfiguration.
recommendation: Match the other routes: parse CHAIN_ID strictly and return 500 'Invalid chain configuration' when missing/invalid instead of defaulting to a chain id.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No tp-sl tests exist in the included files.
suggestedRegressionTest: Unit test chainIdFor with unset and non-numeric CHAIN_ID expecting a configuration error rather than the 11155111 fallback.
minimumFixScope: apps/api/src/routes/tp-sl.ts chainIdFor helper (and its call sites).
